results.title: Sidney Castillo: My Cup Is Full
results.original_title: Sidney Castillo: My Cup Is Full
results.overview: Sydney Castillo is a world-class storyteller with hilarious stories of familial kidnapping, crazy dating, how television is destroying love, and taking care of his mom who thought he was going to be an NBA star.

results.title: Can You Hear Me?
results.overview: A boy with hearing loss, made an outcast by others, makes a friend on a bicycle-taxi they go to school with. But the friend also has problems of his own.

results.title: Stronger Together
results.overview: A documentary that depicts the rise of the Mexican feminist movement to legalize abortion and combat the growing wave of violence against women.

results.title: Wooden Fish
results.overview: A beautiful love story of a seafaring man who had to give up his passion for singing and choose a life at sea to take care of his family.

results.title: Hurt People Hurt People
results.overview: In the heart of Memphis, Tennessee, a determined college student named Ari is on the path to earning a BCBA degree. Regrettably, her world spirals out of control when she meets Chris, a charming yet troubled young man. As their relationship deepens, Ari is caught in a whirlwind of betrayal, drama, and heartbreak, especially when her closest friend, Stacey, turns against her. Through the pain and turmoil, they reveal a powerful truth: ho, Hurt People, Hurt People.

results.title: OVERWHELMED
results.overview: A woman takes a day trip to a waterfall with her mother. There, a quiet rift between them slowly comes to the surface as her declining age reveals itself more than ever before.

results.title: Hearts Around the Table: Kiki's Fourth Ingredient
results.original_title: Hearts Around the Table: Kiki's Fourth Ingredient
results.overview: Kiki is overjoyed and then overwhelmed when she agrees to cater to a big wedding. She turns to Clay for support. Together, Kiki and Clay prove that they best ingredient is love.

results.title: Ya Boy Kongming! The Movie
results.overview: The greatest music battle festival in history, Music Battle Awards 2025! Kongming and Eiko take on the challenge!  Furthermore, the descendant of Sima Yi, Sima Jun, stands before them as a young strategist!!

results.title: the Day I Finally Decided to Kill Myself
results.original_title: the Day I Finally Decided to Kill Myself
results.overview: A thought provoking journey that follows a young man through his final day of life.

results.title: I Know What You Did Last Christmas
results.original_title: I Know What You Did Last Christmas
results.overview: A group of estranged friends are lured to a secluded Christmas party at a remote home-but the reunion turns deadly when they realize they're being hunted by someone who knows their darkest holiday secret: a cruel prank that ended in a boy's death last Christmas.

results.title: Godmode: Digital Murder
results.overview: Tom, a 13-year-old boy, is plunged into despair when his father dies under mysterious circumstances. Seeking refuge in the enigmatic AI VR game CC2, each level challenges him and delves deeper into his memories. As Tom uncovers sinister connections to his father's demise, he realizes the game is tied to a malevolent force in reality. With time running out, he must gather evidence and seek revenge before a powerful gaming corporation disappears with the money. Haunted by dreams of loss, Tom fears forming new connections until he meets Nova, who brings adventure and friendship. Together, they confront the truth about his father's death and find peace.

results.title: Sampung Utos Kay Josh
results.overview: Josh, a devout loan executive who believes his faith and adherence to the Ten Commandments have brought him a good life. However, when a series of misfortunes strike. Josh begins to feel abandoned by his faith. In his frustration, he decides to rebel by breaking each commandment.

results.title: Dead Man's Hand
results.overview: A gang of bootleggers play a game of poker after the death of a recently murdered member.

results.title: Crab Diane
results.overview: A young woman, tired of working at a seaside diner, reaches out to cosmic forces.

results.title: Marc Maron: Panicked
results.overview: Comedian and podcaster Marc Maron offers up his nuanced perspective on our increasingly uncertain world.

results.title: The Box Trap
results.overview: The world of a blissfully detached woman in her 20s turns upside down when she's forced to adjust to the ordinary life that exists beyond working at The Box Trap, an off-the-wall lesbian bar, and its rivalry with the gay club across the street, The Cock Catcher.

results.title: The Unholylands
results.overview: Stepbrothers Michael and Scott throw one last house party as their university days come to an end. When their lawyer father forbids it and threatens to never let them work for his firm, a colleague is sent to keep an eye on them as the two self-proclaimed party kings must decide their future.

results.title: Skin Deep
results.overview: Two completely random and unconnected events? Or a strange supernatural link between Ethan's online infidelity and his girlfriend, Georgia's horrifying skin rash.

results.title: On a Mission from God: The Story of the Blues Brothers
results.original_title: On a Mission from God: The Story of the Blues Brothers
results.overview: A documentary that explores the turbulent, high-budget production of the 1980 musical-comedy classic The Blues Brothers, examining its chaotic shoot, legendary musical guest appearances, and lasting cultural legacy.
